[EN] The flowers grow near the Gutrend camp.

[EN] I really hope these flowers will protect me.
[ES] De verdad espero que estas flores me protejan.

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."

[EN] Collect malodorous flowers near the entrance of the Doomcrypt.
[ES] Recoge flores malolientes cerca de la entrada de la Cripta de la Perdición.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Eudon at the entrance to the Doomcrypt.
[ES] Informa a Eudon en la entrada de la Cripta de la Perdición.
